'''Kalda Biss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] agent of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] she helped the [[Evocii]] [[Ganuk]] rescue several slaves from captivity.<ref name="Extermination" />
